text:
Predicates:
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WorkInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCS(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakeDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedByDavid(x) ::: x is instructed by professor David.
WorkInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkInLibrary(x) → ¬FromCS(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (HasPartTimeJob(x) → Student(x) ∧ WorkInLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (TakeDatabaseCourse(x) → FromCS(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructedByDavid(x) → TakeDatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorkInLab(x) → InstructedByDavid(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
WorkInLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬HasPartTimeJob(jack) ∧ ¬WorkInLab(jack) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬HasPartTimeJob(james) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
